headline: Broad-based growth continues as margins slip
summary_short: Revenue rose 16.3% year over year to $882.9M, with operating income up to $273.1M and diluted EPS of $1.57 versus $1.37, as Veeva said results exceeded guidance on all metrics.
summary_long: Total revenue grew 16.3% y/y to $882.9M (subscription $730.2M, +15%), with operating income up 16.8% to $273.1M and diluted EPS of $1.57 versus $1.37 a year ago; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $2.24. R&D & Quality Solutions subscription revenue grew ~19% versus Commercial Solutions' ~11%, the primary growth split. Gross margin slipped to 75.0% from 77.1% as cost of revenue outgrew sales; the release does not explain why. Veeva repurchased $226.9M of stock. The company guided fiscal Q2 revenue to $902-905M and raised full-year revenue guidance to $3,635-3,645M, saying results exceeded guidance on all metrics. Cash plus short-term investments were $7.3B at quarter-end.

drivers.explanation: CFO said results "exceeded guidance on all metrics" amid broad-based growth; CEO points to Veeva AI progress (Ostro, Vault AI, Veeva Falcon) as the company's next growth phase.
R&D & Quality Solutions subscription revenue grew ~19% y/y ($392.3M vs $329.4M) versus Commercial Solutions' ~11% ($337.9M vs $305.4M) — R&D/Quality is this quarter's primary growth engine.
Operating income grew faster than revenue (+16.8% vs +16.3%) as total opex rose only ~10.7% y/y (R&D +13.2%, S&M +12.7%, G&A +0.9%), producing modest operating leverage.
Gross margin slipped to 75.0% from 77.1% as cost of revenue grew ~27% versus 16.3% revenue growth (subscription cost +26.5%, services cost +27.6%); the release does not explain the increase.
